title: Implement until spec passes: R8 inline data and attachments
description: Done when: the wip tag is removed from 08_inline_data.feature, step definitions are written, and cargo test --test bdd passes for its scenarios.

comments.author: example-user
comments.text: Implemented until the spec passes. @wip dropped from features/01_structure/08_inline_data.feature; all 4 scenarios pass (47 total). Schema: KnownPart::InlineData { mime, data (base64 or None), data_ref } with content_hash (sha2 SHA-256 hex over the base64 payload); blob-backed parts carry data_ref without data. New dependency: sha2 0.10. fmt/clippy/doc/doctests/BDD green.

right_now_summary: The inline data spec passes, with step definitions added and all four scenarios green.
